summary: OpenHands/OpenHands is the Agent Canvas web frontend plus Node launchers (bin/agent-canvas.mjs, scripts/dev-*.mjs); it contains no task-running CLI. The runnable agent is the pinned `openhands-agent-server` (software-agent-sdk, version from config/defaults.json versions.agentServer = 1.49.5) that the launchers and docker/entrypoint.sh spawn and then drive over its REST API. The overlay installs that pinned server (sdk/tools/workspace pinned alike, plus the posthog constraint the launcher adds) into a uv venv under /opt/harness and copies the repo to /opt/harness/src so the agent-server imports the repo's tools/canvas_ui_tool.py at startup exactly like scripts/dev-safe.mjs and docker/entrypoint.sh do. The run command starts `agent-server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18000 --import-modules canvas_ui_tool`, then POSTs one conversation (`agent_settings.llm` = model/api_key/base_url with api_mode=chat and native tool calling, LocalWorkspace = the task cwd, worktree=false, initial_message with run=true, NeverConfirm, autotitle off), polls execution_status until finished/error/stuck/idle-after-running, dumps all events to /out/trajectory.json plus conversation.json and agent-server.log, prints the final agent message, and exits 0 on finished/idle. The SDK talks to the model through litellm; with an `openai/<name>` model and base_url=$PROXY_URL/v1 it sends non-streaming OpenAI chat-completions with tool calls (terminal, file_editor, task_tracker, finish, think) — verified against a mock server in both a bookworm and a jammy-based image.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

# Overlay for OpenHands (agent-canvas repo). The runnable agent is the pinned
# `openhands-agent-server` (software-agent-sdk) that this repo's launchers and
# docker/entrypoint.sh start; the version pin comes from config/defaults.json.
# Everything lives under /opt/harness; the base image's python/node are untouched.
ARG OPENHANDS_AGENT_SERVER_VERSION=""
ARG HARNESS_PYTHON=3.12
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git tmux procps \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# uv (self-contained under /opt/harness) + a managed CPython for the harness venv.
ENV UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/bin \
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/.uv-cache \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-managed
RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env INSTALLER_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv python install "${HARNESS_PYTHON}"

# Harness source (tools/canvas_ui_tool.py is imported by the agent-server at
# startup, exactly like scripts/dev-safe.mjs and docker/entrypoint.sh do).
COPY . /opt/harness/src

# Install the agent-server pinned by the repo (config/defaults.json versions.agentServer),
# mirroring scripts/dev-safe.mjs::buildAgentServerCommand (sdk/tools/workspace pinned
# to the same version plus the posthog constraint).
RUN /opt/harness/bin/uv venv /opt/harness/venv --python "${HARNESS_PYTHON}" \
 && VER="${OPENHANDS_AGENT_SERVER_VERSION:-$(/opt/harness/venv/bin/python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/opt/harness/src/config/defaults.json'))['versions']['agentServer'])")}" \
 && echo "Installing openhands-agent-server==${VER}" \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv pip install --python /opt/harness/venv \
      "openhands-agent-server==${VER}" "openhands-sdk==${VER}" \
      "openhands-tools==${VER}" "openhands-workspace==${VER}" "posthog>=6,<7" \
 && ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/agent-server /opt/harness/bin/agent-server \
 && rm -rf /opt/harness/.uv-cache

# Only /opt/harness/bin goes on PATH (agent-server, uv); the venv's python is NOT
# exposed so the task image's own python3 keeps winning.
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:${PATH} \
    OH_EXTRA_PYTHON_PATH=/opt/harness/src/tools \
    OH_ENABLE_VSCODE=false \
    OH_TELEMETRY_EXPORTER=none \
    DO_NOT_TRACK=1 \
    LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True \
    PYTHONUTF8=1
# Login shells (`bash -lc`) re-set PATH from /etc/profile; re-add the harness bin there too.
RUN printf 'case ":$PATH:" in *":/opt/harness/bin:"*) ;; *) export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH ;; esac\n' > /etc/profile.d/harness.sh
run_command:
set -euo pipefail
: "${TASK:?TASK must contain the task text}"
H="${HARNESS_HOME:-/opt/harness}"
HPY="$H/venv/bin/python"
OUT="${OUT_DIR:-/out}"
mkdir -p "$OUT" 2>/dev/null || { OUT=/tmp/out; mkdir -p "$OUT"; }
STATE="${OPENHANDS_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openhands-harness}"
PORT="${OPENHANDS_AGENT_SERVER_PORT:-18000}"
export OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0="${OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0:-$("$HPY" -c 'import secrets;print(secrets.token_hex(16))')}"
export OH_PERSISTENCE_DIR="$STATE" OH_CONVERSATIONS_PATH="$OUT/conversations" OH_BASH_EVENTS_DIR="$STATE/bash_events"
export OH_WORKSPACE_PATH="$PWD" OH_ENABLE_VSCODE=false OH_TELEMETRY_EXPORTER=none DO_NOT_TRACK=1
export OH_EXTRA_PYTHON_PATH="$H/src/tools" LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True PYTHONUTF8=1
export HARNESS_PORT="$PORT" HARNESS_OUT="$OUT" HARNESS_WORKDIR="$PWD" TMUX_TMPDIR="${TMUX_TMPDIR:-/tmp/openhands-tmux}"
mkdir -p "$OH_CONVERSATIONS_PATH" "$OH_BASH_EVENTS_DIR" "$TMUX_TMPDIR"
# The agent-server runs `git init` in a non-git workspace (for its Changes tab); undo that side effect unless asked to keep it.
HAD_GIT=0; [ -e .git ] && HAD_GIT=1
cleanup() { kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; [ "$HAD_GIT" = 1 ] || [ "${HARNESS_KEEP_GIT:-0}" = 1 ] || rm -rf .git; }
"$H/venv/bin/agent-server" --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --import-modules canvas_ui_tool >"$OUT/agent-server.log" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
trap cleanup EXIT
"$HPY" - "$TASK" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
task = sys.argv[1]
base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{os.environ['HARNESS_PORT']}"
out = os.environ["HARNESS_OUT"]
hdr = {"X-Session-API-Key": os.environ["OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0"], "Content-Type": "application/json"}
def call(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=data, method=method, headers=hdr)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
            return json.loads(r.read() or b"null")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{method} {path} -> HTTP {e.code}: {e.read()[:2000].decode(errors='replace')}") from None
t0 = time.time()
while True:
    try:
        call("GET", "/health"); break
    except Exception as e:
        if time.time() - t0 > 180: sys.exit(f"agent-server did not start: {e}")
        time.sleep(1)
llm = {"model": os.environ.get("LLM_MODEL", "openai/gpt-4.1"),
       "api_key": os.environ.get("LLM_API_KEY", "proxy"),
       "base_url": os.environ.get("LLM_BASE_URL") or None,
       "api_mode": "chat", "native_tool_calling": True}
req = {"agent_settings": {"agent_kind": "openhands", "llm": llm, "enable_switch_llm_tool": False},
       "workspace": {"kind": "LocalWorkspace", "working_dir": os.environ["HARNESS_WORKDIR"]},
       "worktree": False, "autotitle": False, "stuck_detection": True,
       "confirmation_policy": {"kind": "NeverConfirm"},
       "max_iterations": int(os.environ.get("HARNESS_MAX_ITERATIONS", "200")),
       "initial_message": {"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": task}], "run": True}}
info = call("POST", "/api/conversations", req)
cid = info["id"]
print(f"[harness] conversation {cid} started in {os.environ['HARNESS_WORKDIR']}", flush=True)
deadline = time.time() + float(os.environ.get("HARNESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS", "3600"))
seen_running, last, started = False, None, time.time()
while True:
    info = call("GET", f"/api/conversations/{cid}")
    st = info.get("execution_status")
    if st != last:
        print(f"[harness] status: {st}", flush=True); last = st
    if st == "running": seen_running = True
    if st in ("finished", "error", "stuck", "paused") or (st == "idle" and (seen_running or time.time() - started > 300)):
        break
    if time.time() > deadline:
        print("[harness] timeout; pausing conversation", flush=True)
        try: call("POST", f"/api/conversations/{cid}/pause")
        except Exception: pass
        st = "timeout"; break
    time.sleep(2)
events, page = [], None
while True:
    q = "?limit=100" + (f"&page_id={page}" if page else "")
    pg = call("GET", f"/api/conversations/{cid}/events/search{q}")
    events += pg.get("items", []); page = pg.get("next_page_id")
    if not page: break
json.dump(events, open(os.path.join(out, "trajectory.json"), "w"), indent=1)
json.dump(info, open(os.path.join(out, "conversation.json"), "w"), indent=1, default=str)
final = ""
for ev in events:
    if ev.get("kind") == "MessageEvent" and ev.get("source") == "agent":
        final = "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in ev.get("llm_message", {}).get("content", []))
    elif ev.get("kind") == "ActionEvent" and ev.get("action", {}).get("kind") == "FinishAction":
        final = ev["action"].get("message", final)
print(f"[harness] final status={st} events={len(events)}\n{final}", flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if st in ("finished", "idle") else 1)
PY
check_command: agent-server --help >/dev/null && /opt/harness/venv/bin/python -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/harness/src/tools"); import canvas_ui_tool, openhands.agent_server; print("openhands agent-server OK")'
notes:
Verified locally (Docker 29.4.3): overlay built on python:3.12-slim-bookworm and on a reconstruction of the buildpack-deps:jammy + python3.11 benchmark base; check_command passes in both with --network none and the base image's own python3 remains first on PATH (only /opt/harness/bin is added). A full mock task run in both images had the agent execute `terminal` in the task cwd, call `finish`, exit 0, and write /out/trajectory.json, /out/conversation.json, /out/agent-server.log and /out/conversations/<id>/ (the SDK's own event files). Observed proxy traffic: non-streaming POST /v1/chat/completions, model "gpt-4.1" (litellm strips the openai/ prefix), tools terminal/file_editor/task_tracker/finish/think; no other outbound calls seen (VS Code server disabled, telemetry off, litellm cost-map fetch disabled, chromium/browser tool absent so the browser preload is skipped with a logged warning).

Design choices: (1) This repo has no headless CLI; bin/agent-canvas.mjs starts a web stack (agent-server + automation backend via uvx + ingress) and configures the LLM only through the UI, so the recipe reproduces the repo's docker/entrypoint.sh agent-server launch line (`agent-server --port N --import-modules canvas_ui_tool`, OH_EXTRA_PYTHON_PATH=<repo>/tools) and drives one conversation through the REST API the frontend itself uses (POST /api/conversations with initial_message.run=true, poll execution_status, GET events/search). The version pin is read from the repo's config/defaults.json at build time (override with --build-arg OPENHANDS_AGENT_SERVER_VERSION). (2) `api_mode: "chat"` is set explicitly because the SDK auto-selects the OpenAI Responses API for models whose litellm metadata lists /v1/responses (gpt-4.1 does), which the proxy does not speak. Any `openai/<name>` model works; for the Anthropic API instead set LLM_MODEL=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 and LLM_BASE_URL=$PROXY_URL (litellm appends /v1/messages). (3) Side effects: the agent-server unconditionally runs `git init` in a non-git workspace; the run command removes that .git afterwards unless the directory already was a repo or HARNESS_KEEP_GIT=1. Conversation state is stored under /out/conversations, other server state under /tmp/openhands-harness; a fresh random session API key is generated per run. (4) The task's `.git`/worktree isolation is disabled (worktree=false) so edits land in the cwd. Optional knobs: OPENHANDS_AGENT_SERVER_PORT (default 18000), HARNESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (pause + exit 1 on expiry), HARNESS_MAX_ITERATIONS. Exit code is 0 for finished/idle, 1 for error/stuck/paused/timeout. tmux is installed so the terminal tool uses its production tmux backend (it falls back to subprocess without it). Build needs network for apt, the uv installer, a managed CPython 3.12 (the SDK requires >=3.12) and PyPI; runtime needs only the proxy.
